thread:
pm_rohan: quick standup on the embeddings + rerank schema. we have two competing asks: customer X wants per-item auditability for rerank signals; customer Y insists on the smallest possible wire for high-volume embedding calls. need a single contract that supports both with minimal churn.
sophie: thinking in modes helps: default = compact (minimal telemetry), verbose = debug (opt-in). we can add a top-level `response_mode: compact|verbose` that controls extra fields.
kevin: +1. compact mode should only include request_id, model, model_version, tokens_in/out/total, trace_id (opt-out), and the embedding or candidates. verbose adds prompt_text, full_candidate_meta, and tools_called.
anya: small naming note: prefer `tokens_in`, `tokens_out`, `tokens_total` for parity with other endpoints. agree on snake_case.
jules: for rerank we need to ship per-candidate minimal traceability. propose `candidates: [{candidate_id, score, signal_hash?}]` where `signal_hash` is a short base64 digest of the feature vector used for rerank (opaque to customers). that satisfies audit without blowing up size.
infra-bot: [system] Logging/PII check: including `prompt_text` by default flagged. enforce `include_prompt: boolean` and org-level `allow_prompt_logging`. :warning:
kevin: about trace vs request id: expose `request_id` always. `trace_id` only present when `expose_trace` is true in org settings or when customer opts-in at call-level. we need an `expose_trace` org toggle.
sophie: compact embedding example (for doc PR):
```json
{
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "response_mode": "compact",
  "request_id": "req_2028",
  "model": "rwd-embed-lite-v2",
  "model_version": "2026-03-01",
  "tokens_in": 8,
  "tokens_out": 0,
  "tokens_total": 8,
  "embedding": [0.002, -0.11, ...],
  "meta": {"region":"eu-central-1"}
}
```
kevin: and a compact rerank snippet: 
```json
{
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "response_mode": "compact",
  "request_id": "req_3030",
  "model": "rwd-rerank-smol",
  "candidates": [
    {"candidate_id":"c_101","score":0.91,"signal_hash":"h1"},
    {"candidate_id":"c_205","score":0.21,"signal_hash":"h2"}
  ]
}
```
anya: verbose mode adds `prompt_text`, `full_candidates` (array of full candidate objects), `tools_called`, and `debug_logs`. these are gated and disabled by default.
jules: migration note: older SDKs expect `usage: {input,output,total}`. we'll provide a small translation table in the migration guide and SDK helpers: tokens_in -> usage.input etc.
pm_rohan: SLOs for launch: embedding median payload delta (over baseline) must be < 120 bytes. verbose fields may be excluded on GA unless org enables them. docs + example SDK mappings required.
infra-bot: telemetry quota note: verbose mode increases log ingestion. recommend canary with max 5 orgs enabled and quota guardrails.
sophie: small API ergonomics: keep `meta` as a tiny free-form map only. avoid adding more top-level keys; runtime should ignore unknown meta keys.
kevin: security: add `expose_trace` org setting and `include_prompt` call param. both default false. record audit events when they are enabled.
anya: final naming decision: snake_case, `schema_version` top-level, `response_mode` top-level, `request_id` visible to customer, `trace_id` optional. per-candidate fields must be compact.
pm_rohan: launch checklist: 1) spec PR with compact+verbose examples (jules + sophie) 2) SDK mapping PRs (py/ts) 3) doc + migration guide for tokens rename (kevin) 4) infra canary gating + quota (infra-bot/ops) 5) pick 3 pilot orgs for canary (pm). aim to ship canary in 2 weeks.
jules: will draft the spec PR today and include size estimates for compact mode (median bytes).
kevin: will add migration helper in SDKs and test vectors.
infra-bot: [system] Note: flagged fields for compliance review if `include_prompt` or `full_candidates` are enabled.
pm_rohan: thanks all. closing this thread; PR ping when ready. :rocket:
